name: prograin-site
description: Bilingual Prograin website built with Next.js

scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts docs README.md package.json vercel.json site.webmanifest.json next.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts docs README.md package.json vercel.json site.webmanifest.json next.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run check
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/check-site.mjs && node scripts/check-seo-browser.mjs && node scripts/check-interactions.mjs && node scripts/check-ui.mjs
